description: This file defines the SupportsDelete interface, a mix-in for supporting delete operations in data source tables within Apache Spark's SQL connector framework. It includes methods for checking delete feasibility, performing deletes based on filters or predicates, and truncating tables.

classes.name: SupportsDelete
classes.description: An interface providing support for delete operations on data source tables, including methods to check delete capability, perform deletes, and truncate tables.

methods.name: canDeleteWhere
methods.description: Checks if data can be deleted from the table given filter expressions.

methods.name: deleteWhere
methods.description: Deletes data matching the provided filter expressions.

methods.name: canDeleteWhere
methods.description: Default method to check delete capability using predicates, converting them to filters.

methods.name: deleteWhere
methods.description: Default method to delete data using predicates, converting them to filters.

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Attempts to truncate the table by deleting all data if supported.
